---
title: "R Notebook to compute restoration effort in Somalia (AARAN)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mclust)

set.seed(42)
terraOptions(memfrac = 0.8, progress = 1)
output_dir <- "outputs_report"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
tree_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/treecover/somalia_treecover_2024_2025_250m.tif"
erosion_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/erosion/somalia_erosion_2024_2025_250m.tif"
ph_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/ph/somalia_ph_2024_2025_250m.tif"
soc_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/soc/somalia_2024_2025_soc.tif"
rdr50_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/RDR50/RDR50_2024_2025_250m.tif"
points_file <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/sample_df.csv"
```

```{r}
ecosystem <- rast(c(tree_file, erosion_file, rdr50_file, ph_file, soc_file))
names(ecosystem) <- c("TreeCover", "Erosion", "RDR50", "pH", "SOC")
NAflag(ecosystem) <- -9999

global(ecosystem, c("min", "max", "mean"), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot(
  ecosystem,
  main = c("Tree Cover", "Erosion", "RDR50", "Soil pH", "Soil Organic Carbon")
)
```

```{r}
pts <- read.csv(points_file) |>
  terra::vect(geom = c("x", "y"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

pts <- terra::project(pts, terra::crs(ecosystem))
sample_df <- terra::extract(ecosystem, pts, xy = TRUE, ID = FALSE) |> tidyr::drop_na()

summary(sample_df)
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
predictors <- c("TreeCover", "Erosion", "RDR50", "pH", "SOC")
sample_scaled <- scale(as.matrix(sample_df[, predictors]))

indicator_means <- attr(sample_scaled, "scaled:center")
indicator_sds <- attr(sample_scaled, "scaled:scale")

gmm_model <- Mclust(sample_scaled, G = 3, verbose = FALSE)

cluster_data <- sample_df |>
  mutate(cluster = as.integer(gmm_model$classification))


table(cluster_data$cluster)

```

```{r}
cluster_summary <- cluster_data |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(TreeCover, Erosion, RDR50, pH, SOC),
      list(
        median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q25 = ~quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q75 = ~quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(cluster_summary)
```

```{r}
cluster_data |>
  pivot_longer(TreeCover:SOC, names_to = "Indicator", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(cluster), Value, fill = factor(cluster))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~Indicator, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

```{r}
vals <- terra::values(ecosystem)
ok <- complete.cases(vals)

cls <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(vals))
cls[ok] <- predict(
  gmm_model,
  newdata = scale(vals[ok, , drop = FALSE], indicator_means, indicator_sds)
)$classification

cluster_raster <- ecosystem[[1]]
values(cluster_raster) <- cls
names(cluster_raster) <- "cluster"

writeRaster(cluster_raster, file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_ecosystem_GMM_clusters.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
plot(cluster_raster, main = "GMM Ecosystem Clusters")
```

```{r}
# Assign classes after looking at the summary table (assigned low effort to cluster 2 instead due to the higher SOC and low erosion although cluster one had higher tree cover)
manual_classification <- data.frame(
  cluster = 1:3,
  effort_class = c(2, 1, 3),
  restoration_effort = c("Medium effort", "Low effort", "High effort")
)

knitr::kable(manual_classification)
```

```{r}
restoration_effort <- terra::classify(
  cluster_raster,
  as.matrix(manual_classification[, c("cluster", "effort_class")]),
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_restoration_effort.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

levels(restoration_effort) <- data.frame(
  ID = 1:3,
  restoration_effort = c("Low effort", "Medium effort", "High effort")
)

plot(restoration_effort, main = "Restoration Effort")
```
```{r}
cluster_data <- sample_df |>
  mutate(cluster = as.integer(gmm_model$classification)) |>
  left_join(manual_classification, by = "cluster") |>
  mutate(
    met_low    = as.integer(restoration_effort == "Low effort"),
    met_medium = as.integer(restoration_effort == "Medium effort"),
    met_high   = as.integer(restoration_effort == "High effort")
  )

cluster_data
```
```{r}
library(randomForest)
set.seed(42)

predictors <- c("TreeCover", "Erosion", "RDR50", "pH", "SOC")
```


```{r}
# model for low effort restoration areas
set.seed(42)

rf_low <- randomForest(
  x = cluster_data[, predictors],
  y = factor(cluster_data$met_low),
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE,
  sampsize = c("0" = 6500, "1" = 6500)
)
saveRDS(rf_low, file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_rf_low.rds"))
rf_low
```

```{r}
# model for medium effort restoration areas
set.seed(42)
rf_medium <- randomForest(
  x = cluster_data[, predictors],
  y = factor(cluster_data$met_medium),
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE,
  sampsize = c("0" = 6500, "1" = 6500)
)
saveRDS(rf_medium, file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_rf_medium.rds"))
rf_medium
```

```{r}
# model for high effort restoration areas
set.seed(42) 
rf_high <- randomForest(
  x = cluster_data[, predictors],
  y = factor(cluster_data$met_high),
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE,
  sampsize = c("0" = 3800, "1" = 3800)
)
saveRDS(rf_high, file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_rf_high.rds"))
rf_high
```
```{r}
# plot the variables in order of importance (I used mean decrease accuracy because it ranks based on the influence of the indicator in increasing model error when moved about)
# =======================================
plot_importance <- function(rf_model, title) {
  imp_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model)) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") |>
    arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

  ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = reorder(Variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy), y = MeanDecreaseAccuracy)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Mean Decrease Accuracy") +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_importance(rf_low, "Variable Importance - Low Effort")
plot_importance(rf_medium, "Variable Importance - Medium Effort")
plot_importance(rf_high, "Variable Importance - High Effort")
```
```{r}
prob_low <- terra::predict(
  ecosystem, rf_low,
  type = "prob", index = 2,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_effort_prob_low.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
names(prob_low) <- "low_effort_probability"
plot(prob_low, main = "Predicted Probability - Low Effort")
```

```{r}
prob_medium <- terra::predict(
  ecosystem, rf_medium,
  type = "prob", index = 2,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_effort_prob_medium.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
names(prob_medium) <- "medium_effort_probability"
plot(prob_medium, main = "Predicted Probability - Medium Effort")
```

```{r}

```{r}
# Create rgb raster
output_dir <- "../raster/somalia_mosaic_ld/"

high   <- rast(file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_effort_prob_high.tif"))
medium <- rast(file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_effort_prob_medium.tif"))
low    <- rast(file.path(output_dir, "AARAN_effort_prob_low.tif"))

effort_rgb <- c(high, medium, low) * 255
names(effort_rgb) <- c("High", "Medium", "Low")

plotRGB(effort_rgb, stretch = "lin", main = "Restoration Effort Probability")
`
